audited.name: Stadtwerke Leipzig GmbH
audited.result: Fresh evidence materially changes the Leipzig resolution path. First-party Stadtwerke Leipzig still confirms anonymous ad-hoc access through the station QR flow. Additional post-2024 sites are now evidenced: Kurt-Eisner-Strasse 100 (2x Type 2 22 kW; surfaced 2025) and Coppistrasse/Etkar-Andre-Strasse (2x CCS 50 kW plus 1x Type 2 22 kW; surfaced 2025), in addition to the first-party P+R Neue Messe deployment (2 HPC units / 4 points up to 400 kW plus 4 AC Duo / 8 points up to 22 kW). More importantly, a fresh secondary source states ad-hoc at Stadtwerke-owned points is 0.54 EUR/kWh AC and 0.64 EUR/kWh DC, conflicting with the previously captured secondary report of 0.65/0.75 EUR/kWh. Because the first-party tariff page explicitly labels 0.54/0.64 as the registered regular L-Strom.drive tariff rather than ad-hoc, neither secondary interpretation is promoted. Leipzig is therefore reclassified operationally as a B7 tariff-source conflict nested inside the existing B1 post-2024 coverage task. Fail-closed remains mandatory until the ad-hoc checkout/price surface or another explicit first-party ad-hoc price statement resolves the conflict.
audited.nextAction: Query the public ad-hoc checkout/QR surface for explicit current AC/DC price binding without initiating a charge or bypassing controls; continue enumerating post-2024 Stadtwerke Leipzig EVSEs from BNetzA/Mobilithek. Do not promote 0.54/0.64 or 0.65/0.75 until first-party ad-hoc semantics are explicit.

consistencyCheck.repeatInvestigationGuard: PASS: Leipzig gained new post-2024 site evidence and, critically, a newly identified contradictory ad-hoc tariff claim; investigation path changes to direct checkout conflict resolution rather than repeating generic tariff search.
consistencyCheck.materialProgress: Two additional post-2024 Leipzig sites are evidenced and an unsafe potential tariff substitution was caught before promotion.

nextSafeAction: Resolve Leipzig ad-hoc price semantics directly from its public QR/checkout surface, then return to Allgaeuer residual EVSE-to-zone mapping when a concrete EVSE identity/source is available. Keep GEW/Goettingen dormant absent new fee-completeness evidence.
